system.implants: Basic Biomods, Basic Mesh Inserts, Cortical Stack, Cyberbrain, Mnemonic Augmentation, Puppet Sock
system.advantages: +10 SOM, +5 to one other aptitude of the player's choice
system.description:
Part exalt human, part machine, these basic pods are virtually indistinguishable from humans. Worker pods are often used in menial labor jobs where interaction with humans is necessary.

Source: Eclipse Phase Morph Recognition Guide, p. 110.
